lines.zh: 我走得很慢，腿不太听话。
lines.en: I walk slowly. My legs don't quite obey.

lines.zh: 制服还穿在身上，已经烂了。
lines.en: The uniform is still on me, rotted through.

lines.zh: 我一步一拖，脚在地上刮。
lines.en: I drag one foot, scraping the floor.

lines.zh: 我朝着有人声的地方走。
lines.en: I walk toward the sound of voices.
My hands hang and never lift.
The corridor lights flicker. I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤已经变成绿色。
lines.en: My skin has turned green.
I pass bloodstains without stopping.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤是绿的，正在烂。
lines.en: My skin is green and rotting.
I follow the wall, looking for a way out.
Every step takes effort.
I smell something alive.

lines.zh: 绿色的斑爬上我的下巴。
lines.en: Green blotches climb my jaw.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里发出低低的声音。
lines.en: A low sound comes from my throat.

lines.zh: 制服上的名字，我已经看不清。
lines.en: I can't read the name on my uniform.

lines.zh: 我在等，等活的东西靠近。
lines.en: I wait for something living to come near.

lines.zh: 防护服里的人，早就不动了。
lines.en: The man in the suit stopped moving long ago.

lines.zh: 我变绿了，生命也翻了一倍。
lines.en: I turned green, and my health doubled.
The light went out. I don't need it.
I've stood here a long time.
The wound doesn't hurt. Nothing hurts.
I remember being on guard duty.
Then someone opened the door.
I hear the vent humming.
My skin has gone green.

lines.zh: 我把手举到眼前，看了很久。
lines.en: I hold a hand up to my eyes for a long while.
You're in a hazmat suit. I know it.

lines.zh: 我记得我也穿过那样的。
lines.en: I remember wearing one of those.
You've stepped back. Good.
There are only two blocks between us.
Two blocks is enough.
I won't run. I walk slowly.
But I keep walking.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，比我的热多了。
lines.en: Your breath is far warmer than mine.
I'm looking at your neck.
Don't take the mask off.
Take it off and you'll be like me.
I raise my hands, very slowly.
This isn't surrender.
It's just that I lift them slowly.
If you run, I won't chase fast.
What I can't catch, something else will.

lines.zh: 这一层，已经没有干净的人了。
lines.en: There's no one clean left on this floor.
Listen. They're all behind the walls.

lines.zh: 我身上没有一个地方疼。
lines.en: Not one part of me hurts.

lines.zh: 这一下，只是让我慢了一点。
lines.en: That only slowed me a little.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖先着地，又挺直。
lines.en: My knees hit first, then straighten.
My arm is broken. It still works.

lines.zh: 黑血从面罩缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Black blood seeps through my mask's seam.
You can't stop me by hitting.
I get up and walk toward you.
You'll still have to come close.
Close is all it takes.
I don't need to win.
You've raised something.

lines.zh: 我要的不是食物，是活人。
lines.en: It's not food I want — it's the living.
It's you I want.
I turned green, and my blood doubled.
Within two blocks, you can't escape.
That's not food. That's protection.
That thing in your hand, I don't care.
The virus stretches my hand out.

lines.zh: 你挡不住的，病毒会找到你。
lines.en: You can't stop it — the virus finds you.
Just so long as your skin is bare.
You ran into me. I'm hard.

lines.zh: 我的防毒面罩歪到一边。
lines.en: My gas mask knocks askew.
My hand touched you.
That once was enough.
I've started after you.

lines.zh: 我撞在门框上，又转回来。
lines.en: I hit the doorframe and turn back.

lines.zh: 我的防护服，挡得住感染。
lines.en: This hazmat suit keeps the infection out.
I never get angry.
I just follow.
You push me off and I press close again.
That word. I remember it.
It means nothing now.
All that's left of me is going forward.
And passing it on.
It doesn't need both parties willing.
Just contact. That's all.
I remember having a home.
I've forgotten the number on the door.
I can't recall my wife's face.
I remember she was afraid of the dark.
I pick it up and look at it.
A keycard. The photo is me.
I stood straighter then.
I crush it in my hand.
I drop it and walk on.
A radio is squawking.
Someone inside is calling a number.
Not my number.
I drop that too.
These aren't what I want.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头有人，穿着防护服吗？
lines.en: Someone's at the corridor's end — with a hazmat suit?
I hear the footsteps stop.
He's seen me.
He's seen me. Better still.
I start walking toward him.
Not fast. Just walking.
He's backed to the wall.
There's no way along the wall.
My hazmat suit is torn.
Two blocks of distance left.
Only one block left.
My hand has touched him.
He's starting to cough.
I've locked onto your body heat.
He's walking now too.
The same direction as me.
I follow the hazmat suit.

lines.zh: 他跑得比我快，可他会累。
lines.en: He's faster, and he'll tire.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚，撞开每一道门。
lines.en: I drag my feet and shoulder through each door.
The doors he shut, I shoulder through.
I hear him panting inside.

lines.zh: 我在你的门外，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand outside your door, perfectly still.
I don't knock. I use my palm.
I hit it with my palm.

lines.zh: 我的指节一下下刮着墙。
lines.en: My knuckles scrape the wall, again and again.
The door isn't very strong.
He's moving deeper in.
There's no exit in there.
I remember this floor's plan.
I'll wait at the door.
The corridor is long; I'm in no hurry.
Always have been.
The inner door has opened.
He's backed to the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 我的指甲陷进你的袖子。
lines.en: My nails sink into your sleeve.
He pulls twice and can't get free.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，往墙上带。
lines.en: I seize your collar and swing you into the wall.
I never once bit him.
I only need contact.
He hits my head. I don't dodge.
My head tips, then straightens.
He's wearing gloves. That's fine.
There's nothing at his neck.
I reach for it.
He's clawing at his own throat.
He slides down against the wall.

lines.zh: 我贴到你身侧，张开了嘴。
lines.en: I press to your side and open my mouth.
I stand by and wait for him to rise.
He will get up.
They all get up.

lines.zh: 我从一间锁着的房间走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of a locked room.
I opened it myself.
My uniform still has a number.

lines.zh: 编号下面的名字，被血盖住了。
lines.en: The name under it is covered in blood.
The emergency lights in the corridor are red.
I walk toward the red light.

lines.zh: 我记得这条路通向大厅。
lines.en: I remember this way leads to the hall.
There should still be people there.
I prop myself on the wall to stand.
But I can walk.
I can always walk.

lines.zh: 这层楼的警报已经停了。
lines.en: The alarms on this floor have stopped.
The alarms stopped too late.

lines.zh: 我把面罩上的血擦了擦。
lines.en: I wipe the blood off my mask.
The blood on the mask won't come off.
So I wear it like this.
Someone's coming down the corridor.
I hear those footsteps.
I'm on fire, and still walking.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上滚下去，骨头断了。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and bones break.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我照样站着。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs. I stand anyway.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，我爬回来。
lines.en: The blast throws me down and I crawl back.

lines.zh: 子弹打进我的胸口，我继续走。
lines.en: A bullet goes into my chest. I keep walking.
A light binds me and I strain against it.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃东西了，也不觉得饿。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in a long time and don't feel it.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我焦了一半。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and half of me is charred.

lines.zh: 我掉进黑里，还在往前走。
lines.en: I fall into the dark and keep walking.
